  identifier: 'foo'
  actual   body_text: 'def foo():\n    return 1\n'

trigger_summary: When a source file lacks a trailing newline and an indexed function span reaches the file's last line, get_functions_by_file unconditionally appends a newline to body_text, deviating from the verbatim exact source text required by the specification.
